verses.display_text: Jonathan told David, saying, “Saul seeks to put you to death. So be on your guard tomorrow morning, hide, and remain concealed.

verses.text: I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you may be. I will speak about you to my father, see what happens, and report to you.”
verses.display_text: I will go out and stand beside my father in the field where you may be. I will speak about you to my father, see what happens, and report to you.”

verses.text: Jonathan spoke good things about David to his father Saul and said to him, “Let the king not sin against your servant David, for he has not sinned against you, and his deeds are very good.
verses.display_text: Jonathan spoke good things about David to his father Saul and said to him, “Let the king not sin against your servant David, for he has not sinned against you, and his deeds are very good.

verses.text: He placed his soul in his hand and struck the foreigner, and the Lord brought about a great deliverance. All Israel saw and rejoiced. Why do you sin against innocent blood by putting David to death without cause?”
verses.display_text: He placed his soul in his hand and struck the foreigner, and the Lord brought about a great deliverance. All Israel saw and rejoiced. Why do you sin against innocent blood by putting David to death without cause?”

verses.text: Saul listened to Jonathan’s voice, and Saul swore, saying, “As the Lord lives, he shall not die.”
verses.display_text: Saul listened to Jonathan’s voice, and Saul swore, saying, “As the Lord lives, he shall not die.”

verses.text: Jonathan called David and told him all these words. Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was before him as in former days.
verses.display_text: Jonathan called David and told him all these words. Jonathan brought David to Saul, and he was before him as in former days.

verses.text: War broke out again against Saul. David grew strong, fought the foreigners, and struck them with a very great blow, and they fled before him.
verses.display_text: War broke out again against Saul. David grew strong, fought the foreigners, and struck them with a very great blow, and they fled before him.

verses.text: An evil spirit of God came upon Saul while he was sleeping in the house with a spear in his hand. David was playing with his hands.
verses.display_text: An evil spirit of God came upon Saul while he was sleeping in the house with a spear in his hand. David was playing with his hands.

verses.text: Saul sought to drive the spear into David, but David moved away from Saul, and Saul drove the spear into the wall. David withdrew and escaped.
verses.display_text: Saul sought to drive the spear into David, but David moved away from Saul, and Saul drove the spear into the wall. David withdrew and escaped.

verses.text: That night Saul sent messengers to David’s house to watch him so as to put him to death in the morning. His wife Michal told David, saying, “If you do not save your own soul this night, tomorrow you will be put to death.”
verses.display_text: That night Saul sent messengers to David’s house to watch him so as to put him to death in the morning. His wife Michal told David, saying, “If you do not save your own soul this night, tomorrow you will be put to death.”

verses.text: Michal lowered David through the window. He went away, fled, and was saved.
verses.display_text: Michal lowered David through the window. He went away, fled, and was saved.

verses.text: Michal took the funerary images and placed them on the bed. She put the goats’ liver at its head and covered them with a garment.
verses.display_text: Michal took the funerary images and placed them on the bed. She put the goats’ liver at its head and covered them with a garment.

verses.text: Saul sent messengers to take David, and they said that he was ill.
verses.display_text: Saul sent messengers to take David, and they said that he was ill.

verses.text: He sent for David, saying, “Bring him to me on the bed, so that I may put him to death.”
verses.display_text: He sent for David, saying, “Bring him to me on the bed, so that I may put him to death.”

verses.text: The messengers came, and there were the funerary images on the bed, with the goats’ liver at its head.
verses.display_text: The messengers came, and there were the funerary images on the bed, with the goats’ liver at its head.

verses.text: Saul said to Michal, “Why have you deceived me this way and sent my enemy away, so that he escaped?” Michal said to Saul, “He said, ‘Send me away; otherwise I will kill you.’”
verses.display_text: Saul said to Michal, “Why have you deceived me this way and sent my enemy away, so that he escaped?” Michal said to Saul, “He said, ‘Send me away; otherwise I will kill you.’”

verses.text: David fled and escaped. He came to Samuel at Armathaim and told him all that Saul had done to him. David and Samuel went and stayed at Nauath in Ramah.
verses.display_text: David fled and escaped. He came to Samuel at Armathaim and told him all that Saul had done to him. David and Samuel went and stayed at Nauath in Ramah.

verses.text: It was reported to Saul, saying, “Behold, David is at Nauath in Ramah.”
verses.display_text: It was reported to Saul, saying, “Behold, David is at Nauath in Ramah.”

verses.text: Saul sent messengers to take David. They saw the assembly of prophets, with Samuel standing, appointed over them. The Spirit of God came upon Saul’s messengers, and they prophesied.
verses.display_text: Saul sent messengers to take David. They saw the assembly of prophets, with Samuel standing, appointed over them. The Spirit of God came upon Saul’s messengers, and they prophesied.

verses.text: It was reported to Saul, and he sent other messengers; they too prophesied. Saul sent messengers a third time, and they too prophesied.
verses.display_text: It was reported to Saul, and he sent other messengers; they too prophesied. Saul sent messengers a third time, and they too prophesied.

verses.text: Saul burned with anger and went himself to Armathaim. He came as far as the well of the threshing floor at Sephi and asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” They said, “Behold, at Nauath in Ramah.”
verses.display_text: Saul burned with anger and went himself to Armathaim. He came as far as the well of the threshing floor at Sephi and asked, “Where are Samuel and David?” They said, “Behold, at Nauath in Ramah.”

verses.text: He went from there to Nauath in Ramah. The Spirit of God came upon him too, and he went on prophesying until he came to Nauath in Ramah.
verses.display_text: He went from there to Nauath in Ramah. The Spirit of God came upon him too, and he went on prophesying until he came to Nauath in Ramah.

verses.text: He stripped off his garments and prophesied before them. He fell naked all that day and all the night. Therefore they said, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”
verses.display_text: He stripped off his garments and prophesied before them. He fell naked all that day and all the night. Therefore they said, “Is Saul also among the prophets?”

verses.text: David escaped from Nauath in Ramah. He came before Jonathan and said, “What have I done? What is my wrong, and how have I sinned before your father, that he seeks my soul?”
verses.display_text: David escaped from Nauath in Ramah. He came before Jonathan and said, “What have I done? What is my wrong, and how have I sinned before your father, that he seeks my soul?”

verses.text: Jonathan said to him, “By no means shall that happen to you! You certainly shall not die. Behold, my father will certainly do nothing great or small without uncovering my ear. Why would my father hide this matter? It is not so.”
verses.display_text: Jonathan said to him, “By no means shall that happen to you! You certainly shall not die. Behold, my father will certainly do nothing great or small without uncovering my ear. Why would my father hide this matter? It is not so.”

verses.text: David answered Jonathan and said, “Your father knows well that I have found favour in your eyes. He says, ‘Let Jonathan not know this, lest he refuse.’ But as the Lord lives and as your soul lives, as I said, the space between me and death has been filled.”
verses.display_text: David answered Jonathan and said, “Your father knows well that I have found favour in your eyes. He says, ‘Let Jonathan not know this, lest he refuse.’ But as the Lord lives and as your soul lives, as I said, the space between me and death has been filled.”

verses.text: Jonathan said to David, “What does your soul desire, and what shall I do for you?”
verses.display_text: Jonathan said to David, “What does your soul desire, and what shall I do for you?”

verses.text: David said to Jonathan, “Behold, tomorrow is the new moon, and I will certainly not sit with the king to eat. Let me go, so that I may hide in the plain until evening.
verses.display_text: David said to Jonathan, “Behold, tomorrow is the new moon, and I will certainly not sit with the king to eat. Let me go, so that I may hide in the plain until evening.

verses.text: If your father inquires after me, say, ‘David earnestly asked my leave to run to Bethlehem, his city, because the yearly sacrifice for the whole tribe is there.’
verses.display_text: If your father inquires after me, say, ‘David earnestly asked my leave to run to Bethlehem, his city, because the yearly sacrifice for the whole tribe is there.’

verses.text: If he says, ‘Good,’ there is peace for your servant. But if he answers you harshly, know that evil has been determined by him.
verses.display_text: If he says, ‘Good,’ there is peace for your servant. But if he answers you harshly, know that evil has been determined by him.

verses.text: Show mercy to your servant, for you have brought your servant into a covenant of the Lord with yourself. If there is wrong in your servant, put me to death yourself. Why do you bring me to your father in this way?”
verses.display_text: Show mercy to your servant, for you have brought your servant into a covenant of the Lord with yourself. If there is wrong in your servant, put me to death yourself. Why do you bring me to your father in this way?”

verses.text: Jonathan said, “By no means shall that happen to you! If I know that evil has been determined by my father to come upon you—and if not—I will report it to you in your cities.”
verses.display_text: Jonathan said, “By no means shall that happen to you! If I know that evil has been determined by my father to come upon you—and if not—I will report it to you in your cities.”

verses.text: David said to Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers harshly?”
verses.display_text: David said to Jonathan, “Who will tell me if your father answers harshly?”

verses.text: Jonathan said to David, “Go and remain in the field.” Both of them went out to the field.
verses.display_text: Jonathan said to David, “Go and remain in the field.” Both of them went out to the field.

verses.text: Jonathan said to David, “The Lord, the God of Israel, knows that I will question my father when the time comes a third time. If there is good concerning David, shall I not send to you in the field?
verses.display_text: Jonathan said to David, “The Lord, the God of Israel, knows that I will question my father when the time comes a third time. If there is good concerning David, shall I not send to you in the field?

verses.text: May God do so to Jonathan, and more besides, for I will bring the evils upon you, uncover your ear, and send you away, and you shall go in peace. The Lord will be with you as He was with my father.
verses.display_text: May God do so to Jonathan, and more besides, for I will bring the evils upon you, uncover your ear, and send you away, and you shall go in peace. The Lord will be with you as He was with my father.

verses.text: While I am still alive, you shall show mercy to me; and if I indeed die,
verses.display_text: While I am still alive, you shall show mercy to me; and if I indeed die,

verses.text: you shall never remove your mercy from my house. And may it not be, when the Lord removes David’s enemies, every one, from the face of the earth,
verses.display_text: you shall never remove your mercy from my house. And may it not be, when the Lord removes David’s enemies, every one, from the face of the earth,

verses.text: that Jonathan’s name be removed from David’s house. May the Lord seek out David’s enemies.”
verses.display_text: that Jonathan’s name be removed from David’s house. May the Lord seek out David’s enemies.”

verses.text: Jonathan swore again to David, because he loved the soul of the one who loved him.
verses.display_text: Jonathan swore again to David, because he loved the soul of the one who loved him.

verses.text: Jonathan said, “Tomorrow is the new moon. You will be sought, because your seat will be inspected.
verses.display_text: Jonathan said, “Tomorrow is the new moon. You will be sought, because your seat will be inspected.

verses.text: You shall do so a third time and look about, and come to your place where you hid on the working day. Stay beside that ergab.
verses.display_text: You shall do so a third time and look about, and come to your place where you hid on the working day. Stay beside that ergab.

verses.text: I will do so three times with the shafts, hurling them toward the amattari.
verses.display_text: I will do so three times with the shafts, hurling them toward the amattari.

verses.text: Then I will send the little boy, saying, ‘Come, find the shaft for me.’ If I say to the little boy, ‘Here, the shaft is on this side of you; take it,’ come, for there is peace for you and no danger, as the Lord lives.
verses.display_text: Then I will send the little boy, saying, ‘Come, find the shaft for me.’ If I say to the little boy, ‘Here, the shaft is on this side of you; take it,’ come, for there is peace for you and no danger, as the Lord lives.

verses.text: If I say to the young man, ‘Here, the shaft is beyond you,’ go, for the Lord has sent you away.
verses.display_text: If I say to the young man, ‘Here, the shaft is beyond you,’ go, for the Lord has sent you away.

verses.text: As for the word we have spoken, you and I, behold, the Lord is a witness between me and you for ever.”
verses.display_text: As for the word we have spoken, you and I, behold, the Lord is a witness between me and you for ever.”

verses.text: David hid in the field. The month arrived, and the king came to the table to eat.
verses.display_text: David hid in the field. The month arrived, and the king came to the table to eat.

verses.text: The king sat on his seat as usual, on the seat by the wall, and preceded Jonathan. Abner sat beside Saul, and David’s place was inspected.
verses.display_text: The king sat on his seat as usual, on the seat by the wall, and preceded Jonathan. Abner sat beside Saul, and David’s place was inspected.

verses.text: Saul said nothing that day, for he said, “It is an occurrence; he appears not to be clean, for he has not been purified.”
verses.display_text: Saul said nothing that day, for he said, “It is an occurrence; he appears not to be clean, for he has not been purified.”

verses.text: The next day of the month, the second day, David’s place was inspected. Saul said to his son Jonathan, “Why has Jesse’s son not come to the table, either yesterday or today?”
verses.display_text: The next day of the month, the second day, David’s place was inspected. Saul said to his son Jonathan, “Why has Jesse’s son not come to the table, either yesterday or today?”

verses.text: Jonathan answered Saul and said to him, “David asked my leave to go to Bethlehem, his city.
verses.display_text: Jonathan answered Saul and said to him, “David asked my leave to go to Bethlehem, his city.

verses.text: He said, ‘Please send me away, for we have a sacrifice of the tribe in the city, and my brothers have commanded me. Now, if I have found favour in your eyes, let me get away and see my brothers.’ That is why he has not come to the king’s table.”
verses.display_text: He said, ‘Please send me away, for we have a sacrifice of the tribe in the city, and my brothers have commanded me. Now, if I have found favour in your eyes, let me get away and see my brothers.’ That is why he has not come to the king’s table.”

verses.text: Saul burned with great anger against Jonathan and said to him, “Son of deserting girls! Do I not know that you are a companion of Jesse’s son, to your shame and the shame of your mother’s exposure?
verses.display_text: Saul burned with great anger against Jonathan and said to him, “Son of deserting girls! Do I not know that you are a companion of Jesse’s son, to your shame and the shame of your mother’s exposure?

verses.text: As long as Jesse’s son lives on the earth, your kingship will not be established. Now send and fetch the young man, for this one is a son of death.”
verses.display_text: As long as Jesse’s son lives on the earth, your kingship will not be established. Now send and fetch the young man, for this one is a son of death.”

verses.text: Jonathan answered Saul, “Why should he die? What has he done?”
verses.display_text: Jonathan answered Saul, “Why should he die? What has he done?”

verses.text: Saul raised the spear against Jonathan to put him to death. Jonathan knew that this evil had been determined by his father: to put David to death.
verses.display_text: Saul raised the spear against Jonathan to put him to death. Jonathan knew that this evil had been determined by his father: to put David to death.

verses.text: Jonathan sprang up from the table in furious anger and ate no bread on the second day of the month, for he was crushed over David, because his father had determined against him.
verses.display_text: Jonathan sprang up from the table in furious anger and ate no bread on the second day of the month, for he was crushed over David, because his father had determined against him.

verses.text: In the morning Jonathan went out to the field, as he had arranged, for the testimony of David, and a little boy was with him.
verses.display_text: In the morning Jonathan went out to the field, as he had arranged, for the testimony of David, and a little boy was with him.

verses.text: He said to the little boy, “Run, find for me the shafts I am hurling.” The little boy ran, and he hurled the shaft and sent it past.
verses.display_text: He said to the little boy, “Run, find for me the shafts I am hurling.” The little boy ran, and he hurled the shaft and sent it past.

verses.text: The little boy came to the place of the shaft Jonathan had hurled. Jonathan shouted after the young man and said, “There, the shaft is beyond you.”
verses.display_text: The little boy came to the place of the shaft Jonathan had hurled. Jonathan shouted after the young man and said, “There, the shaft is beyond you.”

verses.text: Jonathan shouted after his little boy, saying, “Quickly! Hurry! Do not stand still!” Jonathan’s little boy gathered the shafts for his master.
verses.display_text: Jonathan shouted after his little boy, saying, “Quickly! Hurry! Do not stand still!” Jonathan’s little boy gathered the shafts for his master.

verses.text: The little boy knew nothing; only Jonathan and David knew the matter.
verses.display_text: The little boy knew nothing; only Jonathan and David knew the matter.

verses.text: Jonathan gave his equipment to his little boy and said to his little boy, “Go, enter the city.”
verses.display_text: Jonathan gave his equipment to his little boy and said to his little boy, “Go, enter the city.”

verses.text: When the little boy had entered, David rose from the ergab, fell on his face, and bowed to him three times. Each kissed the other and wept with the other, until a great completion.
verses.display_text: When the little boy had entered, David rose from the ergab, fell on his face, and bowed to him three times. Each kissed the other and wept with the other, until a great completion.

verses.text: Jonathan said, “Go in peace, since the two of us have sworn in the Lord’s name, saying, ‘The Lord shall be a witness between me and you, and between my seed and your seed, for ever.’”
verses.display_text: Jonathan said, “Go in peace, since the two of us have sworn in the Lord’s name, saying, ‘The Lord shall be a witness between me and you, and between my seed and your seed, for ever.’”

verses.text: David rose and went away, and Jonathan entered the city.
verses.display_text: David rose and went away, and Jonathan entered the city.

verses.text: David came to Nomba, to Abimelech the priest. Abimelech was astonished at meeting him and said to him, “Why are you alone, with no one with you?”
verses.display_text: David came to Nomba, to Abimelech the priest. Abimelech was astonished at meeting him and said to him, “Why are you alone, with no one with you?”

verses.text: David said to the priest, “The king commanded me a matter today and said to me, ‘Let no one know the matter on which I am sending you and concerning which I commanded you.’ I have solemnly instructed the young men at the place called God’s Faithfulness, Phellani Allemoni.
verses.display_text: David said to the priest, “The king commanded me a matter today and said to me, ‘Let no one know the matter on which I am sending you and concerning which I commanded you.’ I have solemnly instructed the young men at the place called God’s Faithfulness, Phellani Allemoni.

verses.text: Now, if five loaves are at hand, give me whatever is available.”
verses.display_text: Now, if five loaves are at hand, give me whatever is available.”

verses.text: The priest answered David and said, “There are no common loaves at hand, only holy loaves. If the young men have kept themselves from a woman, then he may eat.”
verses.display_text: The priest answered David and said, “There are no common loaves at hand, only holy loaves. If the young men have kept themselves from a woman, then he may eat.”

verses.text: David answered the priest and said to him, “But we have abstained from a woman yesterday and the third day. When I went out on the road, all the young men had been purified. The road itself is common, for it will be sanctified today through my equipment.”
verses.display_text: David answered the priest and said to him, “But we have abstained from a woman yesterday and the third day. When I went out on the road, all the young men had been purified. The road itself is common, for it will be sanctified today through my equipment.”

verses.text: Abimelech the priest gave him the loaves of presentation, for there was no bread there except the loaves of the Presence, removed from before the Lord so that hot bread could be set out on the day he took them.
verses.display_text: Abimelech the priest gave him the loaves of presentation, for there was no bread there except the loaves of the Presence, removed from before the Lord so that hot bread could be set out on the day he took them.

verses.text: One of Saul’s young servants was there that day, detained, neessaran, before the Lord. His name was Doeg the Syrian, tending Saul’s mules.
verses.display_text: One of Saul’s young servants was there that day, detained, neessaran, before the Lord. His name was Doeg the Syrian, tending Saul’s mules.

verses.text: David said to Abimelech, “See whether a spear or sword is here at hand. I have not brought my sword or the equipment, because the king’s matter was urgent.”
verses.display_text: David said to Abimelech, “See whether a spear or sword is here at hand. I have not brought my sword or the equipment, because the king’s matter was urgent.”

verses.text: The priest said, “Behold, the sword of Goliath the foreigner, whom you struck in the Valley of Elah: it is wrapped in a garment. If you desire to take it, take it, for there is no other here.” David said, “Behold, there is none like it. Give it to me.”
verses.display_text: The priest said, “Behold, the sword of Goliath the foreigner, whom you struck in the Valley of Elah: it is wrapped in a garment. If you desire to take it, take it, for there is no other here.” David said, “Behold, there is none like it. Give it to me.”

verses.text: He gave it to him. David rose and fled that day from Saul, and David came to Achish, king of Gath.
verses.display_text: He gave it to him. David rose and fled that day from Saul, and David came to Achish, king of Gath.

verses.text: Achish’s servants said to him, “Is this not David, the king of the land? Is this not the one for whom the dancing women led the song, saying, ‘Saul has struck his thousands, and David his tens of thousands’?”
verses.display_text: Achish’s servants said to him, “Is this not David, the king of the land? Is this not the one for whom the dancing women led the song, saying, ‘Saul has struck his thousands, and David his tens of thousands’?”

verses.text: David placed the words in his heart and became very afraid of Achish, king of Gath.
verses.display_text: David placed the words in his heart and became very afraid of Achish, king of Gath.

verses.text: He altered his face before him and pretended that day. He drummed on the city’s doors, was carried about in his hands, and fell against the gate’s doors. His saliva ran down onto his beard.
verses.display_text: He altered his face before him and pretended that day. He drummed on the city’s doors, was carried about in his hands, and fell against the gate’s doors. His saliva ran down onto his beard.

verses.display_text: Achish said to his servants, “Behold, you see a man subject to fits. Why have you brought him to me?”

verses.text: “Do I lack people subject to fits, that you have brought him to have fits before me? This one shall not enter a house.”

verses.text: David went from there and escaped, and he came to the cave of Adullam. His brothers and his father’s house heard, and they went down to him there.
verses.display_text: David went from there and escaped, and he came to the cave of Adullam. His brothers and his father’s house heard, and they went down to him there.

verses.display_text: Everyone in need, everyone in debt, and everyone pained in soul gathered to him. He became their leader, and about four hundred men were with him.

verses.display_text: David went from there to Mizpeh of Moab and said to Moab’s king, “Please let my father and mother stay with you, until I know what God will do for me.”

verses.text: Saul heard that David and the men with him had been discovered. Saul was sitting on the hill below the cultivated ground in Ramah, the spear in his hand, and all his servants stood beside him.
verses.display_text: Saul heard that David and the men with him had been discovered. Saul was sitting on the hill below the cultivated ground in Ramah, the spear in his hand, and all his servants stood beside him.

verses.text: Saul said to his servants standing beside him, saying to them, “Listen, please, sons of Benjamin! Will Jesse’s son really give all of you fields and vineyards and appoint all of you commanders of hundreds and commanders of thousands?
verses.display_text: Saul said to his servants standing beside him, saying to them, “Listen, please, sons of Benjamin! Will Jesse’s son really give all of you fields and vineyards and appoint all of you commanders of hundreds and commanders of thousands?

verses.text: For all of you have conspired against me. No one uncovers my ear when my son makes a covenant with Jesse’s son. None of you suffers for me or uncovers my ear that my son has raised my servant against me as an enemy, as on this day.”
verses.display_text: For all of you have conspired against me. No one uncovers my ear when my son makes a covenant with Jesse’s son. None of you suffers for me or uncovers my ear that my son has raised my servant against me as an enemy, as on this day.”

verses.text: The king sent to summon Abimelech son of Ahitub and all the sons of his father, the priests at Nomba. All of them came to the king.
verses.display_text: The king sent to summon Abimelech son of Ahitub and all the sons of his father, the priests at Nomba. All of them came to the king.

verses.display_text: Saul said, “Listen, please, son of Ahitub.” He said, “Here I am. Speak, lord.”

verses.text: Saul said to him, “Why have you conspired against me, you and Jesse’s son, by giving him bread and a sword and inquiring for him through God, to set him against me as an enemy, as on this day?”
verses.display_text: Saul said to him, “Why have you conspired against me, you and Jesse’s son, by giving him bread and a sword and inquiring for him through God, to set him against me as an enemy, as on this day?”

verses.text: He answered the king and said, “Who among all your servants is as faithful as David, the king’s son-in-law, commander of all your orders and renowned in your house?
verses.display_text: He answered the king and said, “Who among all your servants is as faithful as David, the king’s son-in-law, commander of all your orders and renowned in your house?

verses.text: Did I begin inquiring for him through God today? By no means! Let the king lay no charge against his servant or against all my father’s house, for your servant knew nothing of all these things, small or great.”
verses.display_text: Did I begin inquiring for him through God today? By no means! Let the king lay no charge against his servant or against all my father’s house, for your servant knew nothing of all these things, small or great.”

verses.text: King Saul said, “You shall surely die, Abimelech, you and all your father’s house.”
verses.display_text: King Saul said, “You shall surely die, Abimelech, you and all your father’s house.”

verses.text: The king said to the runners stationed around him, “Bring them forward and put the Lord’s priests to death, for their hand is with David. They knew that he was fleeing and did not uncover my ear.” But the king’s servants were unwilling to bring their hands against the Lord’s priests.
verses.display_text: The king said to the runners stationed around him, “Bring them forward and put the Lord’s priests to death, for their hand is with David. They knew that he was fleeing and did not uncover my ear.” But the king’s servants were unwilling to bring their hands against the Lord’s priests.

verses.text: The king said to Doeg, “You turn and strike the priests.” Doeg the Syrian turned and put the Lord’s priests to death that day: three hundred and five men, all wearing an ephoud.
verses.display_text: The king said to Doeg, “You turn and strike the priests.” Doeg the Syrian turned and put the Lord’s priests to death that day: three hundred and five men, all wearing an ephoud.

verses.text: He struck Nomba, the priests’ city, with the sword’s edge: men and women, infants and nursing children, calves, donkeys, and sheep.
verses.display_text: He struck Nomba, the priests’ city, with the sword’s edge: men and women, infants and nursing children, calves, donkeys, and sheep.

verses.text: One son of Abimelech son of Ahitub was saved; his name was Abiathar. He fled after David.
verses.display_text: One son of Abimelech son of Ahitub was saved; his name was Abiathar. He fled after David.

verses.text: Abiathar told David that Saul had put all the Lord’s priests to death.
verses.display_text: Abiathar told David that Saul had put all the Lord’s priests to death.

verses.text: David said to Abiathar, “I knew that day that Doeg the Syrian would surely tell Saul. I am responsible for the souls of your father’s house.
verses.display_text: David said to Abiathar, “I knew that day that Doeg the Syrian would surely tell Saul. I am responsible for the souls of your father’s house.

verses.text: Stay with me; do not fear. Wherever I seek a place for my soul, I will seek one for your soul too, for you are protected with me.”
verses.display_text: Stay with me; do not fear. Wherever I seek a place for my soul, I will seek one for your soul too, for you are protected with me.”

verses.text: It was reported to David, saying, “Behold, the foreigners are fighting at Keilah. They are plundering and trampling the threshing floors.”
verses.display_text: It was reported to David, saying, “Behold, the foreigners are fighting at Keilah. They are plundering and trampling the threshing floors.”

verses.text: David inquired through the Lord, saying, “Shall I go and strike these foreigners?” The Lord said, “Go, and you will strike these foreigners and save Keilah.”
verses.display_text: David inquired through the Lord, saying, “Shall I go and strike these foreigners?” The Lord said, “Go, and you will strike these foreigners and save Keilah.”

verses.text: David’s men said to him, “Behold, we are afraid here in Judea. How will it be if we go to Keilah? We will go into the foreigners’ spoils.”
verses.display_text: David’s men said to him, “Behold, we are afraid here in Judea. How will it be if we go to Keilah? We will go into the foreigners’ spoils.”

verses.text: David inquired again through the Lord. The Lord answered him and said to him, “Rise and go down to Keilah, for I am handing the foreigners into your hands.”
verses.display_text: David inquired again through the Lord. The Lord answered him and said to him, “Rise and go down to Keilah, for I am handing the foreigners into your hands.”

verses.text: David and the men with him went to Keilah. He fought the foreigners, and they fled before him. He drove away their livestock and struck them with a great blow. David saved Keilah’s inhabitants.
verses.display_text: David and the men with him went to Keilah. He fought the foreigners, and they fled before him. He drove away their livestock and struck them with a great blow. David saved Keilah’s inhabitants.

verses.text: When Abiathar son of Abimelech fled to David, he went down with David to Keilah, having an ephoud in his hand.
verses.display_text: When Abiathar son of Abimelech fled to David, he went down with David to Keilah, having an ephoud in his hand.

verses.text: It was reported to Saul that David had come to Keilah. Saul said, “God has sold him into my hands, for he has been shut in by entering a city with doors and bars.”
verses.display_text: It was reported to Saul that David had come to Keilah. Saul said, “God has sold him into my hands, for he has been shut in by entering a city with doors and bars.”

verses.text: Saul commanded all the people to go down to Keilah for war, to hem in David and his men.
verses.display_text: Saul commanded all the people to go down to Keilah for war, to hem in David and his men.

verses.text: David knew that Saul was not keeping silent about the evil concerning him. David said to Abiathar the priest, “Bring the Lord’s ephoud.”
verses.display_text: David knew that Saul was not keeping silent about the evil concerning him. David said to Abiathar the priest, “Bring the Lord’s ephoud.”

verses.text: David said, “Lord, God of Israel, Thy servant has heard that Saul seeks to come against Keilah and destroy the city because of me.
verses.display_text: David said, “Lord, God of Israel, Thy servant has heard that Saul seeks to come against Keilah and destroy the city because of me.

verses.text: Will it be shut up? And now, will Saul come down, as Thy servant has heard? Lord, God of Israel, tell Thy servant.” The Lord said, “It will be shut up.”
verses.display_text: Will it be shut up? And now, will Saul come down, as Thy servant has heard? Lord, God of Israel, tell Thy servant.” The Lord said, “It will be shut up.”

verses.text: David and the men with him, about four hundred, rose and went out from Keilah. They went wherever they went. It was reported to Saul that David had escaped from Keilah, and he gave up going out.
verses.display_text: David and the men with him, about four hundred, rose and went out from Keilah. They went wherever they went. It was reported to Saul that David had escaped from Keilah, and he gave up going out.

verses.text: David stayed in the wilderness at Maserem, in the narrow places. He stayed in the wilderness on Mount Ziph, in the parched land. Saul sought him all the days, but the Lord did not hand him into his hands.
verses.display_text: David stayed in the wilderness at Maserem, in the narrow places. He stayed in the wilderness on Mount Ziph, in the parched land. Saul sought him all the days, but the Lord did not hand him into his hands.

verses.text: David saw that Saul was coming out to seek David. David was on the parched mountain at Kaine of Ziph.
verses.display_text: David saw that Saul was coming out to seek David. David was on the parched mountain at Kaine of Ziph.

verses.text: Saul’s son Jonathan rose and went to David at Kaine and strengthened his hands in the Lord.
verses.display_text: Saul’s son Jonathan rose and went to David at Kaine and strengthened his hands in the Lord.

verses.text: He said to him, “Do not fear. My father Saul’s hand certainly will not find you. You will reign over Israel, and I will be second to you. My father Saul knows this.”
verses.display_text: He said to him, “Do not fear. My father Saul’s hand certainly will not find you. You will reign over Israel, and I will be second to you. My father Saul knows this.”

verses.text: The two of them made a covenant before the Lord. David stayed at Kaine, and Jonathan went to his house.
verses.display_text: The two of them made a covenant before the Lord. David stayed at Kaine, and Jonathan went to his house.

verses.text: The Ziphites went up from the parched land to Saul on the hill, saying, “Behold, is David not hidden among us at Messara, in the narrow places at Kaine, on the hill of Echela, to the right of Jessaimoun?
verses.display_text: The Ziphites went up from the parched land to Saul on the hill, saying, “Behold, is David not hidden among us at Messara, in the narrow places at Kaine, on the hill of Echela, to the right of Jessaimoun?

verses.text: Now let the king come down to us according to all his soul’s desire to descend. They have shut him into the king’s hands.”
verses.display_text: Now let the king come down to us according to all his soul’s desire to descend. They have shut him into the king’s hands.”

verses.text: Saul said to them, “Blessed are you by the Lord, for you have taken trouble for me.
verses.display_text: Saul said to them, “Blessed are you by the Lord, for you have taken trouble for me.

verses.text: Please go, prepare further, and find out his place where his foot will be, quickly, there where you said, lest he act cunningly.
verses.display_text: Please go, prepare further, and find out his place where his foot will be, quickly, there where you said, lest he act cunningly.

verses.text: See and find out, and we will go with you. If he is in the land, I will search him out among all Judah’s thousands.”
verses.display_text: See and find out, and we will go with you. If he is in the land, I will search him out among all Judah’s thousands.”

verses.text: The Ziphites rose and went ahead of Saul. David and his men were in the wilderness of Maan, toward the west, to the right of Jessaimoun.
verses.display_text: The Ziphites rose and went ahead of Saul. David and his men were in the wilderness of Maan, toward the west, to the right of Jessaimoun.

verses.text: Saul and his men went to seek him. They reported to David, and he went down to the rock in the wilderness of Maan. Saul heard and pursued David into the wilderness of Maan.
verses.display_text: Saul and his men went to seek him. They reported to David, and he went down to the rock in the wilderness of Maan. Saul heard and pursued David into the wilderness of Maan.

verses.text: Saul and his men went along a side of this mountain, and David and his men were along a side of this mountain. David was keeping under cover to get away from Saul, while Saul and his men camped against David and his men to seize them.
verses.display_text: Saul and his men went along a side of this mountain, and David and his men were along a side of this mountain. David was keeping under cover to get away from Saul, while Saul and his men camped against David and his men to seize them.

verses.text: A messenger came to Saul, saying, “Hurry and come, for the foreigners have attacked the land.”
verses.display_text: A messenger came to Saul, saying, “Hurry and come, for the foreigners have attacked the land.”

verses.text: Saul turned back from pursuing David and went to meet the foreigners. Therefore that place was called the Divided Rock.
verses.display_text: Saul turned back from pursuing David and went to meet the foreigners. Therefore that place was called the Divided Rock.

verses.text: David went up from there and stayed in the narrow places of En-gedi.
verses.display_text: David went up from there and stayed in the narrow places of En-gedi.

verses.text: When Saul returned from following the foreigners, it was reported to him that David was in the wilderness of En-gedi.
verses.display_text: When Saul returned from following the foreigners, it was reported to him that David was in the wilderness of En-gedi.

verses.text: He took with him three thousand chosen men from all Israel and went to seek David and his men in front of Sadaiem.
verses.display_text: He took with him three thousand chosen men from all Israel and went to seek David and his men in front of Sadaiem.

verses.text: He came to the flocks’ herds beside the road, and there was a cave there. Saul entered to attend to himself. David and his men were sitting farther inside the cave.
verses.display_text: He came to the flocks’ herds beside the road, and there was a cave there. Saul entered to attend to himself. David and his men were sitting farther inside the cave.

verses.text: David’s men said to him, “Behold, this is the day of which the Lord spoke to you, to hand your enemy into your hands, and you shall do to him as is good in your eyes.” David rose and secretly removed the flap of Saul’s double cloak.
verses.display_text: David’s men said to him, “Behold, this is the day of which the Lord spoke to you, to hand your enemy into your hands, and you shall do to him as is good in your eyes.” David rose and secretly removed the flap of Saul’s double cloak.

verses.text: After these things David’s heart struck him because he had removed the flap of his double cloak.
verses.display_text: After these things David’s heart struck him because he had removed the flap of his double cloak.

verses.text: David said to his men, “May the Lord forbid that I should do this to my lord, the Lord’s anointed, by bringing my hand against him, for this one is the Lord’s anointed.”
verses.display_text: David said to his men, “May the Lord forbid that I should do this to my lord, the Lord’s anointed, by bringing my hand against him, for this one is the Lord’s anointed.”

verses.text: David persuaded his men with words and did not let them rise and put Saul to death. Saul rose and went down to the road.
verses.display_text: David persuaded his men with words and did not let them rise and put Saul to death. Saul rose and went down to the road.

verses.text: David rose behind him from the cave, and David called after Saul, saying, “Lord king!” Saul looked behind him, and David bent with his face to the ground and bowed to him.
verses.display_text: David rose behind him from the cave, and David called after Saul, saying, “Lord king!” Saul looked behind him, and David bent with his face to the ground and bowed to him.

verses.text: David said to Saul, “Why do you listen to the people’s words, saying, ‘Behold, David seeks your soul’?
verses.display_text: David said to Saul, “Why do you listen to the people’s words, saying, ‘Behold, David seeks your soul’?

verses.text: Behold, on this day your eyes have seen how the Lord handed you into my hand today in the cave. I was unwilling to kill you and spared you. I said, ‘I will not bring my hand against my lord, for this one is the Lord’s anointed.’
verses.display_text: Behold, on this day your eyes have seen how the Lord handed you into my hand today in the cave. I was unwilling to kill you and spared you. I said, ‘I will not bring my hand against my lord, for this one is the Lord’s anointed.’

verses.text: Behold, the flap of your double cloak is in my hand! I removed the flap and did not kill you. Know and see today that there is no evil in my hand, nor impiety or rejection. I have not sinned against you, yet you bind my soul to take it.
verses.display_text: Behold, the flap of your double cloak is in my hand! I removed the flap and did not kill you. Know and see today that there is no evil in my hand, nor impiety or rejection. I have not sinned against you, yet you bind my soul to take it.

verses.text: May the Lord judge between me and you, and may the Lord avenge me on you, but my hand shall not be against you.
verses.display_text: May the Lord judge between me and you, and may the Lord avenge me on you, but my hand shall not be against you.

verses.text: As the ancient proverb says, ‘From the lawless comes wrongdoing,’ but my hand shall not be against you.
verses.display_text: As the ancient proverb says, ‘From the lawless comes wrongdoing,’ but my hand shall not be against you.

verses.text: Now, after whom are you coming out, O king of Israel? Whom are you pursuing? After a dead dog and after a single flea!
verses.display_text: Now, after whom are you coming out, O king of Israel? Whom are you pursuing? After a dead dog and after a single flea!

verses.text: May the Lord be judge and arbiter between me and you. May the Lord see, judge my case, and give judgment for me from your hand.”
verses.display_text: May the Lord be judge and arbiter between me and you. May the Lord see, judge my case, and give judgment for me from your hand.”

verses.text: When David finished speaking these words to Saul, Saul said, “Is this your voice, child David?” Saul raised his voice and wept.
verses.display_text: When David finished speaking these words to Saul, Saul said, “Is this your voice, child David?” Saul raised his voice and wept.

verses.text: Saul said to David, “You are more righteous than I, for you have repaid me with good things, but I have repaid you with evil things.
verses.display_text: Saul said to David, “You are more righteous than I, for you have repaid me with good things, but I have repaid you with evil things.

verses.text: Today you have reported to me the good things you did to me, how the Lord shut me into your hands today and you did not kill me.
verses.display_text: Today you have reported to me the good things you did to me, how the Lord shut me into your hands today and you did not kill me.

verses.text: If someone finds his enemy in distress and sends him away on a good road, the Lord will repay him with good things, as you have done today.
verses.display_text: If someone finds his enemy in distress and sends him away on a good road, the Lord will repay him with good things, as you have done today.

verses.text: Now behold, I know that you shall surely reign, and Israel’s kingdom shall be established in your hands.
verses.display_text: Now behold, I know that you shall surely reign, and Israel’s kingdom shall be established in your hands.

verses.text: Now swear to me by the Lord that you will not destroy my seed after me or make my name disappear from my father’s house.”
verses.display_text: Now swear to me by the Lord that you will not destroy my seed after me or make my name disappear from my father’s house.”

verses.text: David swore to Saul. Saul went to his place, and David and his men went up to narrow Messara.
verses.display_text: David swore to Saul. Saul went to his place, and David and his men went up to narrow Messara.

verses.text: Samuel died. All Israel gathered, mourned him, and buried him at his house in Armathaim. David rose and went down to the wilderness of Maan.
verses.display_text: Samuel died. All Israel gathered, mourned him, and buried him at his house in Armathaim. David rose and went down to the wilderness of Maan.

verses.text: A man lived in Maan, with his flocks at Carmel. The man was very great: he had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats. He was shearing his flock at Carmel.
verses.display_text: A man lived in Maan, with his flocks at Carmel. The man was very great: he had three thousand sheep and a thousand goats. He was shearing his flock at Carmel.

verses.text: The man’s name was Nabal, and his wife’s name was Abigail. His wife had good understanding and was very beautiful in appearance, but the man was harsh and evil in his practices. The man was doglike.
verses.display_text: The man’s name was Nabal, and his wife’s name was Abigail. His wife had good understanding and was very beautiful in appearance, but the man was harsh and evil in his practices. The man was doglike.

verses.text: David heard in the wilderness that Nabal the Carmelite was shearing his flock.
verses.display_text: David heard in the wilderness that Nabal the Carmelite was shearing his flock.

verses.text: David sent ten young men and said to the young men, “Go up to Carmel, go to Nabal, and ask about his welfare in my name.
verses.display_text: David sent ten young men and said to the young men, “Go up to Carmel, go to Nabal, and ask about his welfare in my name.

verses.text: Say this: ‘To the seasons! May it be well with you, and may your house and all that is yours be well.
verses.display_text: Say this: ‘To the seasons! May it be well with you, and may your house and all that is yours be well.

verses.text: Now behold, I have heard that they are shearing for you. Your shepherds were with us in the wilderness; we did not hinder them or impose any order on them all the days they were at Carmel.
verses.display_text: Now behold, I have heard that they are shearing for you. Your shepherds were with us in the wilderness; we did not hinder them or impose any order on them all the days they were at Carmel.

verses.text: Ask your young men, and they will tell you. Let the young men find favour in your eyes, for we have come on a good day. Please give whatever your hand finds to your son David.’”
verses.display_text: Ask your young men, and they will tell you. Let the young men find favour in your eyes, for we have come on a good day. Please give whatever your hand finds to your son David.’”

verses.text: The young men came and spoke these words to Nabal, according to all these sayings, in David’s name. Then he sprang up,
verses.display_text: The young men came and spoke these words to Nabal, according to all these sayings, in David’s name. Then he sprang up,

verses.text: and Nabal answered David’s servants and said, “Who is David, and who is Jesse’s son? Today many slaves withdraw, each from his master.
verses.display_text: and Nabal answered David’s servants and said, “Who is David, and who is Jesse’s son? Today many slaves withdraw, each from his master.

verses.text: Shall I take my loaves, my wine, and my slaughtered offerings—the sheep I slaughtered for my shearers—and give them to men whose origin I do not know?”
verses.display_text: Shall I take my loaves, my wine, and my slaughtered offerings—the sheep I slaughtered for my shearers—and give them to men whose origin I do not know?”

verses.text: David’s young men turned onto their way, returned, came, and reported to David according to these words.
verses.display_text: David’s young men turned onto their way, returned, came, and reported to David according to these words.

verses.text: David said to his men, “Each of you strap on his sword.” About four hundred men went up after David, while the two hundred stayed with the equipment.
verses.display_text: David said to his men, “Each of you strap on his sword.” About four hundred men went up after David, while the two hundred stayed with the equipment.

verses.text: One of the young men reported to Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, “Behold, David sent messengers from the wilderness to bless our master, and he turned away from them.
verses.display_text: One of the young men reported to Abigail, Nabal’s wife, saying, “Behold, David sent messengers from the wilderness to bless our master, and he turned away from them.

verses.text: The men were very good to us. They did not hinder us or impose orders on us all the days we were with them. While we were in the field,
verses.display_text: The men were very good to us. They did not hinder us or impose orders on us all the days we were with them. While we were in the field,

verses.text: they were like a wall around us by night and by day, all the days we were with them tending the flock.
verses.display_text: they were like a wall around us by night and by day, all the days we were with them tending the flock.

verses.text: Now know and see what you will do, for evil has been determined against our master and his house. He is a pestilent son, and one cannot speak to him.”
verses.display_text: Now know and see what you will do, for evil has been determined against our master and his house. He is a pestilent son, and one cannot speak to him.”

verses.text: Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves, two vessels of wine, five prepared sheep, five oiphi of barley meal, one gomor of raisins, and two hundred fig cakes. She placed them on the donkeys.
verses.display_text: Abigail hurried and took two hundred loaves, two vessels of wine, five prepared sheep, five oiphi of barley meal, one gomor of raisins, and two hundred fig cakes. She placed them on the donkeys.

verses.text: She said to her young men, “Go on before me. Behold, I am coming after you.” She did not tell her husband.
verses.display_text: She said to her young men, “Go on before me. Behold, I am coming after you.” She did not tell her husband.

verses.text: As she rode on the donkey and came down under cover of the mountain, there were David and his men coming down to meet her. She met them.
verses.display_text: As she rode on the donkey and came down under cover of the mountain, there were David and his men coming down to meet her. She met them.

verses.text: David said, “Perhaps it was for an unjust man that I guarded all his possessions in the wilderness. We imposed no order to take anything of all he had, yet he has repaid me evil for good.
verses.display_text: David said, “Perhaps it was for an unjust man that I guarded all his possessions in the wilderness. We imposed no order to take anything of all he had, yet he has repaid me evil for good.

verses.text: May God do so to David, and more besides, if I leave by morning anyone of all Nabal has who urinates against a wall.”
verses.display_text: May God do so to David, and more besides, if I leave by morning anyone of all Nabal has who urinates against a wall.”

verses.text: Abigail saw David, hurried, and jumped down from the donkey. She fell before David on her face and bowed to him on the ground,
verses.display_text: Abigail saw David, hurried, and jumped down from the donkey. She fell before David on her face and bowed to him on the ground,

verses.text: at his feet, and said, “On me, my lord, be the wrong. Please let your handmaid speak in your ears, and hear your handmaid’s word.
verses.display_text: at his feet, and said, “On me, my lord, be the wrong. Please let your handmaid speak in your ears, and hear your handmaid’s word.

verses.text: Please let my lord not set his heart on this pestilent man, for as his name is, so is he: Nabal is his name, and folly is with him. But I, your handmaid, did not see your young men whom you sent.
verses.display_text: Please let my lord not set his heart on this pestilent man, for as his name is, so is he: Nabal is his name, and folly is with him. But I, your handmaid, did not see your young men whom you sent.

verses.text: Now, lord, as the Lord lives and as your soul lives, the Lord has restrained you from coming into innocent blood and from saving your hand for yourself. Now may your enemies and those seeking evil for my lord become like Nabal.
verses.display_text: Now, lord, as the Lord lives and as your soul lives, the Lord has restrained you from coming into innocent blood and from saving your hand for yourself. Now may your enemies and those seeking evil for my lord become like Nabal.

verses.text: Now take this blessing, which your handmaid has brought to my lord, and give it to the young men who stand beside my lord.
verses.display_text: Now take this blessing, which your handmaid has brought to my lord, and give it to the young men who stand beside my lord.

verses.text: Please take away your handmaid’s lawless deed. The Lord will surely make my lord a faithful house, for my lord fights the Lord’s war, and evil shall never be found in you.
verses.display_text: Please take away your handmaid’s lawless deed. The Lord will surely make my lord a faithful house, for my lord fights the Lord’s war, and evil shall never be found in you.

verses.text: A person will rise to pursue you and seek your soul, but my lord’s soul shall be bound in the bond of life beside the Lord God. You shall sling the soul of your enemies in the midst of the sling.
verses.display_text: A person will rise to pursue you and seek your soul, but my lord’s soul shall be bound in the bond of life beside the Lord God. You shall sling the soul of your enemies in the midst of the sling.

verses.text: When the Lord does for my lord all the good things He has spoken concerning you, and the Lord appoints you leader over Israel,
verses.display_text: When the Lord does for my lord all the good things He has spoken concerning you, and the Lord appoints you leader over Israel,

verses.text: this shall not be an abomination or a stumbling block for my lord: pouring out innocent blood without cause and saving my lord’s hand for himself. The Lord will do good to my lord, and you shall remember your handmaid to do good to her.”
verses.display_text: this shall not be an abomination or a stumbling block for my lord: pouring out innocent blood without cause and saving my lord’s hand for himself. The Lord will do good to my lord, and you shall remember your handmaid to do good to her.”

verses.text: David said to Abigail, “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, who sent you today, on this day, to meet me.
verses.display_text: David said to Abigail, “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, who sent you today, on this day, to meet me.

verses.text: Blessed be your manner, and blessed are you, who kept me today, on this day, from coming into bloodguilt and from saving my hand for myself.

verses.text: David and his men came to the city, and there it was, burned with fire. Their wives, sons and daughters had been taken captive.
verses.display_text: David and his men came to the city, and there it was, burned with fire. Their wives, sons and daughters had been taken captive.

verses.text: David and his men raised their voices and wept until they no longer had strength to weep.
verses.display_text: David and his men raised their voices and wept until they no longer had strength to weep.

verses.text: Both David’s wives had been taken captive: Ahinoam the Jezreelite and Abigail, the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
verses.display_text: Both David’s wives had been taken captive: Ahinoam the Jezreelite and Abigail, the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

verses.text: David was greatly afflicted, for the people spoke of stoning him. The soul of all the people was in anguish, each over his sons and daughters. But David was strengthened in the Lord his God.
verses.display_text: David was greatly afflicted, for the people spoke of stoning him. The soul of all the people was in anguish, each over his sons and daughters. But David was strengthened in the Lord his God.

verses.text: David said to Abiathar the priest, son of Ahimelech, “Bring the ephoud.”
verses.display_text: David said to Abiathar the priest, son of Ahimelech, “Bring the ephoud.”

verses.text: David inquired through the Lord, “Shall I pursue this geddour? Will I overtake them?” He said to him, “Pursue, for you will certainly overtake and certainly rescue.”
verses.display_text: David inquired through the Lord, “Shall I pursue this geddour? Will I overtake them?” He said to him, “Pursue, for you will certainly overtake and certainly rescue.”

verses.text: David went, he and the six hundred men with him. They came to the Bosor torrent, and those remaining stood still.
verses.display_text: David went, he and the six hundred men with him. They came to the Bosor torrent, and those remaining stood still.

verses.text: He pursued with four hundred men. Two hundred men stayed behind, who sat beyond the Bosor torrent.
verses.display_text: He pursued with four hundred men. Two hundred men stayed behind, who sat beyond the Bosor torrent.

verses.text: They found an Egyptian man in a field, took him, and brought him to David in a field. They gave him bread, and he ate; they gave him water to drink.
verses.display_text: They found an Egyptian man in a field, took him, and brought him to David in a field. They gave him bread, and he ate; they gave him water to drink.

verses.text: They gave him a piece of fruit cake, and he ate. His spirit settled within him, for he had eaten no bread and drunk no water for three days and three nights.
verses.display_text: They gave him a piece of fruit cake, and he ate. His spirit settled within him, for he had eaten no bread and drunk no water for three days and three nights.

verses.text: David said to him, “To whom do you belong, and where are you from?” The Egyptian youth said, “I am a slave of an Amalekite man. My master left me because I fell ill; today is the third day.
verses.display_text: David said to him, “To whom do you belong, and where are you from?” The Egyptian youth said, “I am a slave of an Amalekite man. My master left me because I fell ill; today is the third day.

verses.text: We attacked the south of Cholthi, the regions of Judea, and the south of Cheloub. We burned Ziklag with fire.”
verses.display_text: We attacked the south of Cholthi, the regions of Judea, and the south of Cheloub. We burned Ziklag with fire.”

verses.text: David said to him, “Will you take me down to this geddour?” He said, “Please swear to me by God that you will neither put me to death nor hand me over into my master’s hands, and I will take you down to this geddour.”
verses.display_text: David said to him, “Will you take me down to this geddour?” He said, “Please swear to me by God that you will neither put me to death nor hand me over into my master’s hands, and I will take you down to this geddour.”

verses.text: He took him down there, and there they were, scattered over the whole land, eating, drinking and celebrating with all the great spoils they had taken from the land of the foreigners and the land of Judah.
verses.display_text: He took him down there, and there they were, scattered over the whole land, eating, drinking and celebrating with all the great spoils they had taken from the land of the foreigners and the land of Judah.

verses.text: David came upon them and struck them from daybreak until evening, and on the following day. No man among them was saved except four hundred youths who had mounted camels and fled.
verses.display_text: David came upon them and struck them from daybreak until evening, and on the following day. No man among them was saved except four hundred youths who had mounted camels and fled.

verses.text: David recovered everything the Amalekites had taken, and he rescued both his wives.
verses.display_text: David recovered everything the Amalekites had taken, and he rescued both his wives.

verses.text: Nothing belonging to them was missing, from small to great, from the spoils to sons and daughters and everything they had taken from them. David brought it all back.
verses.display_text: Nothing belonging to them was missing, from small to great, from the spoils to sons and daughters and everything they had taken from them. David brought it all back.

verses.text: David took all the flocks and herds and led them ahead of the spoils. Concerning those spoils it was said, “These are David’s spoils.”
verses.display_text: David took all the flocks and herds and led them ahead of the spoils. Concerning those spoils it was said, “These are David’s spoils.”

verses.text: David came to the two hundred men who had grown too weak to follow David and whom he had seated at the Bosor torrent. They came out to meet David and the people with him. David approached the people, and they asked him about his welfare.
verses.display_text: David came to the two hundred men who had grown too weak to follow David and whom he had seated at the Bosor torrent. They came out to meet David and the people with him. David approached the people, and they asked him about his welfare.

verses.text: Every pestilent and evil man among the warriors who had gone with David answered. They said, “Because they did not pursue with us, we will give them none of the spoils we rescued. Let each take only his wife and children and return.”
verses.display_text: Every pestilent and evil man among the warriors who had gone with David answered. They said, “Because they did not pursue with us, we will give them none of the spoils we rescued. Let each take only his wife and children and return.”

verses.text: David said, “You must not do this, after the Lord has given to us and guarded us. The Lord delivered into our hands the geddour that came against us.
verses.display_text: David said, “You must not do this, after the Lord has given to us and guarded us. The Lord delivered into our hands the geddour that came against us.

verses.text: Who would listen to these words of yours? For they are no less than you. As is the share of the one who goes down into war, so shall be the share of the one who stays with the equipment. They shall share equally.”
verses.display_text: Who would listen to these words of yours? For they are no less than you. As is the share of the one who goes down into war, so shall be the share of the one who stays with the equipment. They shall share equally.”

verses.text: From that day onward, it became a command and a rule for Israel, until today.
verses.display_text: From that day onward, it became a command and a rule for Israel, until today.

verses.text: David came to Ziklag and sent some of the spoils to the elders of Judah and to his neighbors, saying, “Behold, from the spoils of the Lord’s enemies.”
verses.display_text: David came to Ziklag and sent some of the spoils to the elders of Judah and to his neighbors, saying, “Behold, from the spoils of the Lord’s enemies.”

verses.text: He sent it to those in Beth-zur, Ramah of the south and Jeththor;
verses.display_text: He sent it to those in Beth-zur, Ramah of the south and Jeththor;

verses.text: to those in Aroer, to the Ammadi, and to those in Saphi and Esthie;
verses.display_text: to those in Aroer, to the Ammadi, and to those in Saphi and Esthie;

verses.text: to those in Gath, Kinan, Saphek and Thimath;
verses.display_text: to those in Gath, Kinan, Saphek and Thimath;

verses.text: to those in Carmel, the cities of the Ierameli, and the cities of the Kenezi;
verses.display_text: to those in Carmel, the cities of the Ierameli, and the cities of the Kenezi;

verses.text: to those in Ierimouth, Beer-sheba and Noo;
verses.display_text: to those in Ierimouth, Beer-sheba and Noo;

verses.text: to those in Hebron, and to all the places through which David and his men had passed.
verses.display_text: to those in Hebron, and to all the places through which David and his men had passed.

verses.text: The foreigners were fighting against Israel. The men of Israel fled before the foreigners and fell wounded on Mount Gelboue.
verses.display_text: The foreigners were fighting against Israel. The men of Israel fled before the foreigners and fell wounded on Mount Gelboue.

verses.text: The foreigners closed in on Saul and his sons. The foreigners struck down Jonathan, Aminadab and Melchisa, Saul’s sons.
verses.display_text: The foreigners closed in on Saul and his sons. The foreigners struck down Jonathan, Aminadab and Melchisa, Saul’s sons.

verses.text: The war grew heavy against Saul. The missile-throwers, men who were archers, found him, and he was wounded beneath the ribs.
verses.display_text: The war grew heavy against Saul. The missile-throwers, men who were archers, found him, and he was wounded beneath the ribs.

verses.text: Saul said to his armour-bearer, “Draw your sword and pierce me with it, lest these uncircumcised men come, pierce me, and mock me.” His armour-bearer was unwilling, for he was greatly afraid. Saul took the sword and fell on it.
verses.display_text: Saul said to his armour-bearer, “Draw your sword and pierce me with it, lest these uncircumcised men come, pierce me, and mock me.” His armour-bearer was unwilling, for he was greatly afraid. Saul took the sword and fell on it.

verses.text: His armour-bearer saw that Saul was dead. He too fell on his sword and died with him.
verses.display_text: His armour-bearer saw that Saul was dead. He too fell on his sword and died with him.

verses.text: Saul died, and his three sons and his armour-bearer, together on that day.
verses.display_text: Saul died, and his three sons and his armour-bearer, together on that day.

verses.text: The men of Israel beyond the valley and beyond the Jordan saw that the men of Israel had fled and that Saul and his sons had died. They abandoned their cities and fled. The foreigners came and lived in them.
verses.display_text: The men of Israel beyond the valley and beyond the Jordan saw that the men of Israel had fled and that Saul and his sons had died. They abandoned their cities and fled. The foreigners came and lived in them.

verses.text: On the following day, the foreigners came to strip the dead. They found Saul and his three sons fallen on the mountains of Gelboue.
verses.display_text: On the following day, the foreigners came to strip the dead. They found Saul and his three sons fallen on the mountains of Gelboue.

verses.text: They turned him over and stripped off his equipment. They sent it throughout the surrounding land of the foreigners, announcing the news to their idols and their people.
verses.display_text: They turned him over and stripped off his equipment. They sent it throughout the surrounding land of the foreigners, announcing the news to their idols and their people.

verses.text: They dedicated his equipment in the temple of Astarte and fastened his body to the wall of Beth-shan.
verses.display_text: They dedicated his equipment in the temple of Astarte and fastened his body to the wall of Beth-shan.

verses.text: The inhabitants of Jabesh in Gilead heard what the foreigners had done to Saul.
verses.display_text: The inhabitants of Jabesh in Gilead heard what the foreigners had done to Saul.

verses.text: All the mighty men rose and traveled the whole night. They took Saul’s body and the body of Jonathan his son from the wall of Beth-shan, brought them to Jabesh, and burned them there.
verses.display_text: All the mighty men rose and traveled the whole night. They took Saul’s body and the body of Jonathan his son from the wall of Beth-shan, brought them to Jabesh, and burned them there.

verses.text: They took their bones and buried them beneath the cultivated ground at Jabesh. They fasted seven days.
verses.display_text: They took their bones and buried them beneath the cultivated ground at Jabesh. They fasted seven days.
